name: Perch
author: jebin2
description: Mochi, a tiny chibi friend who sits on the corner of your focused window: swings her legs, chats in comic speech bubbles (serious, fun and sassy), waves when you switch windows, scoots out of the pointer's way and naps when you're away.

barWidget.description: Pick her character, change her size, hide her or keep her quiet, and make her wave, yawn or fall.
